g.text: Sensitivity to one omitted library and expression scale
Dot: all six libraries. Line: minimum–maximum over six single-library omissions.
Observed sensitivity ranges are not confidence intervals. All views retain the full-data CPM eligibility filter.
TMM factors are re-estimated per view. Deposited FPKM is a separate scale, not an exact author replay.
Published category names are source labels; qPCR targets are measured here only in deposited RNA.
